topic: What a sitemap is and why Google cares
caption:
Google has to find your pages before it can rank them.
A sitemap tells Google exactly where to look.
Without one, some pages may never show up in search results.
We build every site with a sitemap already set up and submitted. Link in bio.

copy.headline: Google can't rank pages it can't find
copy.body: A sitemap is a file that lists every page on your site. Submit one to Google Search Console and your pages get indexed faster.
